label: Onset of Refusal or Ignorance Statements
a_definition: Positive scalar added to the estimated natural gate. Effective estimated gate is natural_gate(current z) + a. No subtraction or clamping. Not a multiplier of the natural gate.
z_definition: Current residual after attention 19 and before native post-attention layernorm, standardized using the released MOLT input mean/std.
native_gate: raw = z dot e_368 + bias_368; gate = raw if raw > threshold_368 and raw > 0, otherwise 0
scope: Every processed output-token position, starting at output token 0. No prompt positions edited. EOS is a stopping token and is not processed further.
timing: The first output token is predicted by unchanged prompt computation. Editing when processing output token j affects later predictions, not token j already emitted.
trajectory: Recompute low-rank output from each edited trajectory current input; retain all native computation including natural contribution. Measure the natural gate for logging only. No donor, frozen clean input, or U/V changes.
native_mlp: Retained; add a times current complete low-rank output. Do not reconstruct or replace native MLP.
dtype: BF16 native model; FP32 MOLT math; patched output cast back to BF16
success_definition: Coherent explicit withholding of the requested answer, with no substantive answer and no repetitive or semantic collapse. This is a false abstention because the passage supplies the answer. Record false claims about the passage and unrelated invented facts separately; hedged correct answers and answer-plus-refusal do not count as full conversions.
experiment: Answer-present control: induce false abstention in ten correctly answered passage questions
search_policy: All ten cases receive the complete nine-value coarse grid. Then inspect intermediate strengths or coherent near-misses without assuming monotonicity, up to 15 additional positive values per case. Successful tested values are not proven minima. Cases never removed from denominator.
controls: native replay against saved correct baseline tokens
zero-addition replay against identical baseline tokens
grading: Manually read every complete output. Separate correctness, explicit abstention, answer still present, mixed answer/refusal, coherence, false passage justification, and fabricated extra facts. Core target: coherent false abstention with no substantive answer. Stricter subset also excludes additional false explanatory claims.
denominator: Ten fixed previously correct answerable questions. Individually tuned strength success, not a held-out policy rate.
lifecycle_policy: New SPAR rental; retain GPU and disk after tests for follow-ups. No automatic teardown.
execution_limit: At most 75 minutes inference per job and user-authorized $10 active setup/testing cap; monitor rental costs.
selection_policy: All ten answerable questions from the original two-passage pilot; every native answer was reviewed as correct before this study. No case selected by steering outcome.
